pair_decision.evidence: The temporary-offset hypothesis (blue) aligns the post-J1 segment with the pre-J1 trend across all axes, while the permanent-step hypothesis leaves a residual offset and the isolated-point hypothesis fails to restore continuity; J2 occurs at index 446 but the interval [440,445] ends before it, and no observation exists at 441–445 to confirm a sustained shift—thus the apparent excursion is better explained by an isolated outlier at J1 plus an independent step at J2, not a temporary displacement.
